messages.subject: International Infrastructure Executive | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Xavier,

A2 Talent's international infrastructure and leadership-search work across Europe and the Gulf aligns well with my experience in regulated, asset-intensive environments. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where infrastructure delivery depends on credible public-sector engagement, stakeholder alignment and disciplined execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
